# teams_vdi_policies (Data Source)

List every VdiPolicy object (Get-VdiPolicy).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vdi_policies` (Attributes List) All VdiPolicy objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vdi_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--vdi_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vdi_policies`

Read-Only:

- `disable_audio_video_in_calls_and_meetings` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableAudioVideoInCallsAndMeetings parameter.
- `disable_calls_and_meetings` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableCallsAndMeetings parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object.
- `vdi2_optimization` (String) Maps to the -VDI2Optimization parameter.
